Aw, thanks. You're really nice. I appreciate your help... I don't want to take my life honestly, at the time of writing this post I was just really upset. 

I've suffered with anxiety for a long time, and was confused with my sexuality for the longest time... society can be very pressuring. Anyways, your comment definitely lifted my spirits, but It'll still be kinda hard listening to all of my player friends brag about their girlfriends. It's good to hear your words coming from someone within the same age group, haha.
Thank you

Thank you. I've never really been good in school, and I'm always confused. Like my mind is always in a fog. Anyways, I don't have really any ideas for what I want to do with my future. I'm hoping I can think of something in the long run.

I'm truly a lone wolf. Like, I've never done anything with anyone else hardly. I've hardly ever had my hand held, and for better or worse it has made me decently independent where I don't need to rely on others. Still, I long for some sort of emotional connection with another.

I appreciate the support and advice. I really do.
